cohort: Nulliparous (primigravidae) women admitted at term for induction of labor using double priming agents.
finding: The study found no significant difference in the induction-to-delivery interval between Foley catheter with misoprostol and Foley catheter with oxytocin, but the normal vaginal delivery rate was significantly higher in the Foley catheter with oxytocin group.
mod_finding: The normal vaginal delivery rate was significantly higher in the Foley catheter with oxytocin group (100% vs. 80.6%), while caesarean section rates were comparable between both induction methods.
